title: Machu Picchu Full Day
description: Experience the wonder of the world on a full-day tour from Cusco. Cross the Sacred Valley of the Urubamba, ride the panoramic train and explore every corner of the Inca citadel with an expert guide.

itinerary.title: Cusco → Machu Picchu → Cusco
itinerary.description: Hotel pickup at 4:30 am. Transfer to Ollantaytambo to board the train to Aguas Calientes. Arrival at Machu Picchu for a 3-hour guided tour exploring the Temple of the Sun, the Intihuatana Stone and the Sacred Garden. Free time for photos before returning.

notIncludes: Aguas Calientes to Machu Picchu bus (optional)
